capabilities: create notes in a chosen folder via fuzzy path suggestions
create parent folders from / or \ in the note title
bulk-create multiple notes in the same folder
apply templates with {{date}} and {{time}} placeholders and title templates
override Obsidian's native new note button with a chosen command
disambiguation: Not a folder organizer; it only creates new notes in folders you pick at creation time.
extras: README says pairing title templates with normal templates is planned but not yet available.
problem: Creating a note in a specific folder requires navigating the file explorer or switching folders first; there is no built-in way to create a note in an arbitrary folder via quick fuzzy search.
summary: Fuzzy-search note creator that lets you pick a destination folder and title, then opens the new note in the tab, window, or split you choose.
